transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. As a reminder, the process is: technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads each report their final operating requirements, and then I'll make the binding production approval. We've got the Saturday evening gala at the Orpheum, three-camera setup, general caption feed, sponsor product display on stage, and archive reuse currently in the draft package. Who'd like to start with their final requirements?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical requirement before we proceed. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras operating from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure it's reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval, since the current draft package references a three-camera setup but doesn't specify the wired/fixed constraint.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a critical rights requirement to flag. My signed performance license — which I received countersigned this morning and haven't yet entered in the rights tracker — permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive. We need to remove the archive reuse provision before final approval, or we'll be in breach of the license.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a critical talent requirement to flag. I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday, and the rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email, but it is not yet reflected in the production schedule. The soundcheck time constraint needs to be added to the schedule, and the sponsor product display on stage directly conflicts with the rider — it must be removed from the stage area before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I have a critical accessibility requirement to flag. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet. The Booth B assignment needs to be reflected on the lock sheet before final approval.
transcript.speaker: A5
